entities.title: Derive the kind table from the schema
entities.summary: KindTable holds the 26 kinds' required and allowed properties as code, 'generated from schema/utv-1.0.schema.json', but no generator is in the repository and nothing checks the copy.
entities.compromise: The schema's per-kind property lists are copied into KindTable.java by hand or by a tool that is not kept; the C# and Rust libraries read the schema file itself.
entities.cost: A change to schema/utv-1.0.schema.json leaves the Java validator silently out of step; nested value types, enums, $ref and oneOf are not enforced at all (README: structural validation is partial).
acceptanceCriteria: Utv.validateStructural reads schema/utv-1.0.schema.json (for example as a resource), or a check fails when KindTable and the schema disagree.

origin.description: The class comment: generated from schema/utv-1.0.schema.json.

entities.title: Break compareTo ties between 09:30 and 09:30:00
entities.summary: CivilTime and CivilDateTime compare 09:30 and 09:30:00 as equal although they are not equals, against library-api §1.
entities.expected: docs/library-api.md §1: where a language requires ordering to agree with equality (Java's compareTo contract), ties between equal times break by representation, so 09:30 comes before 09:30:00.
entities.observed: compareTo returns 0 for CivilTime.of(9, 30) and CivilTime.of(9, 30, 0), and likewise for date-times; the Java README documents it ('they compare as equal') and TypedApiTest.civilTime asserts it. A TreeSet or TreeMap of such values keeps only one of them.
acceptanceCriteria: CivilTime.of(9, 30).compareTo(CivilTime.of(9, 30, 0)) < 0, and the same for CivilDateTime.
TypedApiTest and the README say so.

entities.title: daysUntil wraps beyond a long
entities.summary: CivilDate.daysUntil reads the JSON layer's BigInteger day count with JsonNode.longValue, which keeps only the low 64 bits.
entities.expected: A day count beyond a long is refused, as elsewhere in the library (Instant.unixSeconds throws ArithmeticException; Period.fromJson answers unsupported, implementation-limit).
entities.observed: Operations.daysBetween returns the exact count (Json.integer makes a BigIntegerNode beyond 64 bits), and daysUntil narrows it silently with JsonNode::longValue. Years are unbounded, so CivilDate.of(BigInteger…) can reach it.
acceptanceCriteria: daysUntil between dates more than 2^63 days apart throws ArithmeticException (or the API returns a BigInteger).

origin.description: CivilDate.daysUntil maps the result with JsonNode::longValue.

entities.title: ZonedIntent.from throws OutcomeException for UTC+01:00 zones
entities.summary: A ZonedDateTime whose zone is an offset-style region (ZoneId.of("UTC+01:00")) is refused with OutcomeException rather than the documented IllegalArgumentException.
entities.expected: ZonedIntent.from's Javadoc: a ZonedDateTime whose zone is only an offset is refused with IllegalArgumentException, pointing to FixedOffsetDateTime.from.
entities.observed: ZonedIntent.from checks only `instanceof ZoneOffset`. For a region id such as UTC+01:00 or GMT+1, JavaTime.fromZonedDateTime builds a fixed-offset date-time, ZonedIntent.fromJson answers invalid (kind-mismatch), and read(...).single() throws OutcomeException.
acceptanceCriteria: ZonedIntent.from throws IllegalArgumentException for every zone that JavaTime.fromZonedDateTime treats as a fixed offset.

origin.description: ZonedIntent.from and JavaTime.fromZonedDateTime disagree on what an offset-only zone is.
